question: Could you analyze our data and identify which ten-year period starting from any movie release year present in the data had the largest number of films, considering consecutive ten-year periods beginning at each unique year? Only output the start year and the total count for that specific period.
sql:
WITH years AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(year, ' ', 1) AS INTEGER) as clean_year
  FROM Movie 
  WHERE TRY_CAST(year AS INTEGER) IS NOT NULL
),
periods AS (
  SELECT clean_year as start_year, clean_year + 9 as end_year
  FROM years
)
SELECT p.start_year, COUNT(m.index) as film_count
FROM periods p
LEFT JOIN Movie m ON TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(m.year, ' ', 1) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN p.start_year AND p.end_year
GROUP BY p.start_year
ORDER BY film_count DESC
LIMIT 1
